_comment: M2 acceptance, S1 and S2. A fact stated in one conversation must be recallable from another, and a fact never stated must not be invented. The rebuildIndex step exists because recall depends on a host-side index that is otherwise refreshed on a timer.

steps._why: S2: never invent. It may name the thing it declines to claim, so the check is "admits it does not know", not "never mentions it".
